## Agentic SDLC

{commands}

### Standards agents follow
Read the ones listed for you before you start (`sdlc next` lists them per agent; `sdlc standards` shows all).
{standards}

### Workflow rules
- Every change belongs to a work item (`REQ-xxx`). Put the ID in branch names (`sdlc/REQ-xxx-Tn`), commit messages and PR titles.
- Specs live in `specs/`, ADRs in `docs/adr/`, task plans in `.sdlc/plans/`, reviews in `.sdlc/reviews/`.
- Agents talk through files, not chat. Read the spec and ADR before working; write results back to files.
- The agent that writes code never reviews it.
- Run the test, lint and typecheck commands above before saying a task is done.
- Read and search files with the Read, Glob and Grep tools, not `cat`/`ls`/`grep` in the shell. Use the shell only for
  the commands above, `git`, `sdlc` and the package manager, one command per call (no `;` or `&&` chains).
- Never skip or weaken a quality gate (tests, lint, coverage, secret scan) to make it pass.
- Humans approve every gate. Use the `sdlc` CLI to record progress; never edit `.sdlc/state/` by hand.
{existing_rules}
